tldr: The Moon in Gemini: emotions need language, variety, and mental movement.
body: With the Moon in Gemini, feelings process through conversation, curiosity, and naming what is happening. You may need to talk your way into clarity before your body can settle.
gift: Emotional adaptability, humor, curiosity, and the ability to translate feelings into words.
challenge: Nervousness, inconsistency, and thinking about feelings instead of feeling them.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
